calibration.note: Auto-accept is OFF: accept_conf is null and route() gates on calibration.status (calibrated only; provisional needs allow_provisional_accept). Quality rejects are OFF: hard_reject_policy=integrity_only (only undecodable/too-short reject; everything else reviews). Hands rule is task-scoped via profiles (assembly requires hands). Pass allow_uncalibrated_accept=True for demo accepts only.
